rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by ACPE-accredited providers (certificate with ACPE Universal Activity Number); American Red Cross or American Heart Association CPR courses, max 1 contact hour per 24 months
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: half of the 30 hours for each complete 12-month period licensed during the concluding license period.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; the board checks CE reported to the ACPE-NABP CPE Monitor and asks for certificates for CE not in CPE Monitor. Disallowed hours must be made up within 90 days.
rules.notes: Vaccinating pharmacists need 1 hour of ACPE-approved immunization CE within the 30 hours. Biennial renewal on a date set by the department, with a CE attestation. Alternative schedule possible for illness or extenuating circumstances.

topics.who: Pharmacists who administer vaccines: ACPE-approved immunization CE, within the 30 hours
